headlines.title: Microsoft, Alphanet, Amazon Earnings Meet Fed Rate Decision: 3 Charts To Watch This Week
headlines.summary: Microsoft and Alphabet report earnings Wednesday, followed by Amazon on Thursday, with investors watching for fresh clues on the AI trade.

headlines.title: Open-Source AI Models Are Catching up to Closed Ones on Accounting Work, DualEntry Benchmark Finds
headlines.summary: NEW YORK, October 26, 2026--Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro got 86.1% of tasks right on the DualEntry Accounting AI Benchmark, placing fourth and ahead of every model from Anthropic, OpenAI and Meta. With Zhipu AI's GLM-5.3 Flash tied for second at 88.1%, two of the top four models are now open.

headlines.title: Meta Is Creating a New Class of Stock. What Shareholders Need to Know
headlines.summary: Meta just unveiled a new class of stock that lets Zuckerberg raise capital without giving up a single vote, and it arrived alongside a quarter that sent shares tumbling on a billion-dollar surprise. What this means for outside shareholders is more complicated than it first appears.

headlines.title: 3 AI Stocks To Own In October 2026
headlines.summary: SpaceX’s huge US$40b debt deal for AI chips signals how much capital is chasing computing power for large models like ChatGPT. Hardware, cloud capacity and software that make this possible can sometimes trade below what their AI potential suggests. That gap is where opportunity may exist. This article highlights three stocks from a focused screener of companies tied directly to the AI buildout that currently appear underappreciated.

headlines.title: Stocks mostly rise before tech earnings, central bank calls
headlines.summary: The world's main stock markets mostly climbed Monday as investors geared up for the week's crucial run of central bank decisions and tech earnings, while oil prices retreated from a six-month high.Europe's main stock markets were higher in late morning deals.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
